alternatives_ranked.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

selection_rationale: All three candidates are scientifically viable.
ApJ has the strongest direct fit to an astrophysical application of a QPP analysis/reproducibility framework to TESS stellar flares.
Its audience is directly aligned with the present astrophysical application and the current 212-word abstract already satisfies the <=250-word constraint.
AASTeX v7 supports the wide/rotated table handling required by the frozen visual package without scientific regeneration.
AAS software/data policies are compatible with the repository/OSF reproducibility architecture.
APC/cost is seventh in the mandated decision order and therefore does not override the higher-order scope/audience/manuscript-fit result.
